title: The Phaistos Disc Mystery
hook: Who carved the symbols on a 3,600-year-old disc?
headline: The Bronze Age Puzzle of Crete

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In 1908 archaeologists uncovered a fired clay disc at Phaistos

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: The disc bears 241 symbols arranged in a spiral no known script matches

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Multiple similar artifacts have been found, including a vase from Knossos, a seal from 1955, and the Arkalochori Axe.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Recent computer analysis suggests the symbols may encode a religious hymn but scholars disagree

end.line: Is the disc a lost language or ritual code?

description: A brief look at the enigmatic Phaistos Disc and its unsolved secrets.
